denominator_rules.cohort: Union of minimal descending-count, spelling-tiebroken 90%-mass prefixes in frequency and EVERY Brown genre; no semantic result used in selection. All dictionary definitions and tail senses retained.
denominator_rules.corpus: All Brown tokens containing at least one alphabetic character, casefolded without lemmatization. Punctuation-only and numeric-only tokens excluded and counted. Contractions and hyphenated forms retained.
denominator_rules.frequency: Existing _priority_source SUBTLEX positive counts, exact complete normalized forms; blank/zero rows excluded by the existing source parser.
